meta.name: technical-blog-writing
meta.description: Technical blog post writing with structure, code examples, and developer audience conventions. Covers post types, code formatting, explanation depth, and developer-specific engagement patterns. Use for: engineering blogs, dev tutorials, technical writing, developer content, documentation posts. Triggers: technical blog, dev blog, engineering blog, technical writing, developer tutorial, tech post, code tutorial, programming blog, developer content, technical article, engineering post, coding tutorial, technical content

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出结构清晰、代码示例丰富的技术博客
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要撰写面向开发者的技术博客或教程
copy.tagline_en: Write structured technical blog posts with code examples
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write developer-focused technical blogs or tutorials

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照技术博客的规范写作，包括教程、深度解析、事故报告等类型，并自动添加可运行的代码示例、图表和开发者友好的语气。
howto.when: 当你要求写技术博客、开发教程、工程博客、技术文章或代码教程时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇关于构建 REST API 的 Node.js 教程。
say.note: Claude 会生成带步骤、代码和结果的完整教程。

say.text: 写一篇关于我们如何用边缘缓存减少 90% API 延迟的工程博客。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含架构图、基准数据和权衡分析的文章。

say.text: 写一篇事故报告，描述上周数据库宕机的原因和修复过程。
say.note: Claude 会按时间线、根因分析和教训的结构输出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude writes technical blog posts following developer conventions, including tutorials, deep dives, postmortems, benchmarks, and architecture posts, with runnable code examples, diagrams, and a direct tone.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write a technical blog, dev tutorial, engineering blog, technical article, or code tutorial.

say_en.text: Write a Node.js tutorial on building a REST API.
say_en.note: Claude generates a full tutorial with steps, code, and results.

say_en.text: Write an engineering blog on how we reduced API latency by 90% with edge caching.
Write a postmortem on last week's database outage.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a timeline, root cause analysis, and lessons learned.
